claims.object_text: voltage-gated sodium channel NaV1.2; generation and forward and back propagation of action potentials in neurons
claims.quote: SCN2A encodes the voltage-gated sodium (Na+) channel α subunit NaV1.2, which is important for the generation and forward and back propagation of action potentials in neurons.
Genetic variants in SCN2A are associated with a spectrum of neurodevelopmental disorders.
seven de novo heterozygous variants in SCN2A in eight individuals with developmental and epileptic encephalopathy (DEE) accompanied by prominent malformation of cortical development (MCD).

The neonatal isoforms of all SCN2A variants studied exhibit gain of function (GoF) with a large depolarized shift in steady-state inactivation, creating a markedly enhanced window current common across all four variants tested.

claims.object_text: NaV1.2-p.Met1770Leu-N variant expression in a developing neocortical pyramidal neuron results in hyperexcitability
claims.quote: Computational modeling demonstrated that expression of the NaV1.2-p.Met1770Leu-N variant in a developing neocortical pyramidal neuron results in hyperexcitability.
